title: TypeScript
tagline: Make JavaScript easier to reason about with types
summary: TypeScript adds a powerful static type system on top of JavaScript. This book takes you from type annotations and inference through unions, generics, narrowing, advanced type manipulation, modules, declaration files, DOM and Node.js typing, React, API boundaries, testing, and large-scale architecture. By the end you'll understand how TypeScript helps you design and reason about JavaScript systems without confusing compile-time types with runtime behavior.
